import polars as pl

df = pl.DataFrame({
    "a": [3, 5, 8, 12, 6],
    "b": [4, 7, 3, 2, 5]
})

result = df.with_columns(
    pl.struct(["a", "b"]).map_elements(
        lambda row: "hi" if row["a"] + row["b"] > 10 else "lo",
        return_dtype=pl.String
    ).alias("category")
)

print(result)
